page.overview:
Who is Evan?

Evan is the pianist, songwriter, and leader of the Zora band The Indigo-Go's. When Lulu, the singer of the band, loses her voice due to her eggs, she goes to see Evan about it. He recommends her that she take the eggs to the to have them checked. Furthermore, he informs the guitarist where he can find empty Bottles and recommends going to talk to the atop the Waterfall Rapids before heading to the Pirates' Fortress to recover the eggs. Evan decides to keep Lulu's problem a secret from the rest of the band members so as to not crush their hopes of performing on the day of the Carnival of Time.

Evan gets upset when he learns that Mikau and Japas are writing music on their own and refuses to hear anything they have composed together. This is the same song that is played during the Band Rehearsal as well as their eventual performance in the Carnival of Time.

Evan is last seen during the ending credits where he and the rest of the band members are performing at the Milk Bar for the carnival.
